title: Laser Pulse Duration
description: Duration of each individual laser pulse, including units. Pulse duration determines the ablation regime: nanosecond (ns) pulses involve significant thermal effects and elemental fractionation; femtosecond (fs) pulses are non-thermal and substantially reduce elemental fractionation and matrix effects. This is a fixed hardware property of the laser system.
